notes: Map runtime is repository-cache-first for known concession and industrial/mining geometries.
Government registries are refresh/audit inputs; a temporary outage must not remove locally archived data.
The national concession inventory archives the last valid official snapshot and never replaces it with an empty/failed fetch.

Raw official XLS/HTML source snapshots are content-addressed by SHA-256 under source-archive/concessions/snapshots, so older source states remain reproducible after an upstream change or disappearance.
The repository-owned NKR party index maps local concession inventory records to NKR GUID/party URLs; browser runtime never queries NKR.
Official concession polygons require an official coordinate register/act and QA; missing geometries are explicit in pending-concessions-v1.json.
Closed/abandoned mining and mining-waste footprints remain in scope independently of current concession status.
OSM/developed footprints and legal concession boundaries are deliberately separate geometries.
